headline: Computacenter Shares Surge on Raised 2026 Profit Outlook
summary: Computacenter shares surged after the company raised its profit outlook for 2026.

impacts.name: Computacenter
impacts.why: Upward revisions to corporate profitability targets increase projected valuation multiples and attract capital.

why_moved: An increased profit outlook signals stronger-than-expected operational performance, prompting an immediate surge in share valuation.
